[SWS_Dlt_00224] Definition of datatype Dlt_MessageType ⌈
Name
Dlt_MessageType
Kind
Enumeration
DLT_TYPE_LOG
0x00
A log message
DLT_TYPE_APP_TRACE
0x01

DLT_TYPE_NW_TRACE
0x02
A message forwarded from a communication
bus (like CAN, FlexRay)
Range
DLT_TYPE_CONTROL

This type describes the type of the message.

Dlt.h
